integrity_notes: An analytic incidence-and-spherical-area proof establishes the exact probabilities. scientific_limitations: Only Haar-uniform central plane sections of the regular Archimedean truncated octahedron in R^3, away from measure-zero nongeneric directions. No offset-plane, stretched-body, or quantitative metric-section law is implied. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Exact polygon-type probabilities for central sections of the truncated octahedron
